findings.note: Oilers preview (Nov 24): EDM is 0-2-1 in its last three, blew a 4-1 lead at STL, and Hyman sat after a vision-affecting migraine. Babcock expects Nugent-Hopkins back. EDM won 3 straight at home and 13 of the last 19 vs VGK.

ESPN game page lists Hyman and Nugent-Hopkins as OUT, with Nov 24 return estimates. It also lists Savoie and Regula on long-term IR and Andersen on IR-NR. VGK is 7-2-2 on the road, and the page shows no Vegas injuries.
Covers lists Edmonton at -130 on the moneyline, while a separate ESPN page showed VGK -118, so the two market snapshots conflict. Covers notes Vegas is 4-0 in its last 4 road games.

Official Oilers preview: Hyman missed the last game with a migraine that affected his vision, and Nugent-Hopkins is likely back. Edmonton ranks 3rd in goals per game at 3.85 but 4th-fewest in shots on goal per game at 24.6, which suggests its scoring depends on finishing and may not hold up.

NHL Gamecenter shows strong power plays on both sides (VGK 27.3%, EDM 32.6%), penalty kills ranked 16th–17th, and Vegas goalies Hart and Hill at .886 and .898 save percentages. These point to a game that could go over. Starting goalies are not confirmed.

The Covers betslip lists trends: the Over is 4-0 in Vegas's last 4 games and 8-1 after Vegas scores 5 or more goals. These are short-sample betting trends, not an expert pick or a projection on the 6.5 total.
